text:
ITEM 1 | Mound of dark green leafy greens with broad, flat, smooth-edged leaves and some smaller ruffled light-green leaves, covering roughly 35-40% of the plate surface, piled about 3-4 cm high, slightly wilted and moist-looking with no visible oil sheen, sitting directly on the white plate | 85
ITEM 2 | Thin orange shreds (julienned, about 4-6 cm long, roughly 0.2 cm wide) scattered through and under the greens, bright orange with slightly translucent edges, raw-looking and crisp, with a few specks | 15
ITEM 3 | Small smear and scattered droplets of reddish-orange dressing or sauce, glossy and moist, pooled in a few spots near the base of the greens and along the shreds, covering about 2% of the plate | 6
ITEM 4 | Thin reddish-purple stems or leaf ribs, about 3-6 cm long, interspersed among the greens, slightly glossy and moist | 4
